name: Zhuhai Zhumian Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhuhai Zhumian Group Co., Ltd. engages in the real estate business in China. It also involved in the duty-free retail, consumer goods, biomedicine, and other business. It also manages large shopping malls, retail businesses, and community commercial projects. The company was formerly known as Gree Real Estate Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Zhuhai Zhumian Group Co., Ltd. in April 2025. Zhuhai Zhumian Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is based in Zhuhai, China.
